wo-jpfa-JR5242.d:
PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu)

Job Responsibilities
* Monitor, operate, and maintain electrical utility systems, including power distribution panels, generators, transformers, and electrical control circuits.
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on all electrical machinery, equipment, and installations in accordance with company safety standards and operating procedures.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair electrical malfunctions and failures promptly to minimize production downtime.
* Conduct regular inspections of utility equipment and document operational data, maintenance logs, and incident reports.
* Assist in the installation, testing, and commissioning of new electrical utility machinery and systems.
* Ensure strict adherence to Occupational Health and Safety (K3) regulations, company policies, and environmental standards.

Job Qualifications
* Minimum of 2–3 years of hands-on experience as an electrical utility operator or maintenance technician, preferably within the manufacturing, food processing, or feedmill industry.
* Strong knowledge of industrial electrical systems, PLC, control wiring, generators, and high/low voltage distributions.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematic drawings and technical manuals.
* Possession of a valid electrical safety certification (K3 Listrik) is highly advantageous.
* Willingness to work in shifts and respond to emergency breakdown calls as required.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

wo-klbf-JR26_002019.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Develop and maintain client relationships.
- Execute sales plan of actions as deployed from superior on monthly and quarterly basis (include plan of customer visit, expenses, sales target per outlet/customer, etc).

- Mengembangkan dan mempertahankan hubungan dengan klien.
- Melaksanakan rencana aksi penjualan yang diberikan oleh atasan secara bulanan dan triwulanan (termasuk rencana kunjungan pelanggan, pengeluaran, target penjualan per outlet/pelanggan, dll).

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
